minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, May 18, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, May 18, 2022.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan and
  Jenny Jolly.

  Members absent: Scott Snider.

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist and Armando
  Cisneros, Recreation Specialist IV.

  Guests present: Kathy Mason.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, April 20,
  2022 meeting. Motion carried.

  Unfinished Business

2. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, there was an average of 117
  participants per week in April.

3. Guest Speaker: Abby Pascua, CEO, Aging Next. Abby spoke about the programs
  available through Aging Next. Their purpose is to educate seniors to be able to stay
  home and live independently. They provide various programs including Volunteer
  Drivers for seniors aged 60 plus. They find drivers to take individuals to doctor
  appointments, grocery shopping or lunch with a friend. There is also a program
  where the individual finds their own driver and they will reimburse mileage at 40
  cents per mile. They also have a Memory Care Center that provides respite for
  caregivers and also provides social activities for the individual. Americorps provides
  funding for RSVP Volunteers. Other programs include: Care Partners, a Resource
  Specialist, and a partnership with Claremont to provide case management to
  residents. Additional programs are listed in their packet of information.

4. Bingo Report: There were new attendees last week and an average of 44 players
  per session in April. Power Ball has been very popular. The equipment is working
  okay but the adapter on the computer needs to be replaced. Volunteers are still
  needed. $905.00 was deposited into the account and expenses for paper totaled
  $1,000.00. The current Bingo balance is $3,655.18.
 5. Meals on Wheels: 717 meals were served to 42 La Verne recipients in April.

6. Account Balance: $4,480.14.

7. Senior Program Fees: Bridge and Woodcarvers are not paid. Scrapbooking is doing
  well; they meet the last Tuesday of every month.

8. MT. SAC Classes: The Request to Register period for summer classes was held
  throughout the month of May.

9. Aging Next: No report.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:

    Tuesday, May 24th- Volunteer Brunch 10:00 AM
    Monday, May 30th- Memorial Day Ceremony, 11:00 AM
    Wednesday, June 8th-Excursion, Santa Monica 9:30 AM
    Friday, June 10th- Excursion, Valley View Casino, 8:30 AM
    Sunday, June 12th-Concert in the Park, 6:30 PM
    Monday, June 13th-Movie Matinee, 12:30PM
    Friday, June 24th-Excursion: Brunch and a Tour at Sofi Stadium, 9:00 AM
    Sunday, June 26th-Concert in the Park 6:30PM
    Thursday, June 30th-Country Western Line Dancing Party, 10:00 AM-
  12:00PM

11. Facilities Report: A new white board was installed in the Senior Activity Room. Vets
  Hall needs another estimate for the kitchen. The lunch program will require lids on
  all trash cans.

12. Public Comments: George gave an update on the Golf Program. It’s slowing down
  some; there were only 14 players last time when there are usually 20. Amanda will
  be researching new Senior Events. Guest, Kathy, told us a little about herself and
  her interests.

13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:30 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, June 15, 2022 at 10:00 AM.
  Gratuity
